const.title: Конституция Республики Абхазия
const.note: Adopted by the Supreme Council on 26 November 1994 (No. 187-s). Arts. 37 (35 deputies, five-year term), 49 (President elected directly for five years), 54 (Vice-President elected with the President), 78-79 (local self-government; heads of district and city administrations appointed by the President), and the constitutional law on its entry into force (point 5: the first President elected by Parliament; point 7: a new Parliament elected in 1995).

law-parl.title: Конституционный закон Республики Абхазия «О выборах депутатов Народного Собрания – Парламента Республики Абхазия»
law-parl.note: Consolidated text as amended to 25 November 2009. Arts. 1 (35 single-member districts), 4 (called by the President), 9 (districts formed by the Central Election Commission), 34 (25% turnout), 35 (results published by the Commission within seven days), 36 (runoff of the top two within two weeks), 37 (repeat elections and by-elections within two months).

law-pres.title: Конституционный закон Республики Абхазия «О выборах Президента Республики Абхазия»
law-pres.note: Consolidated text as amended to 25 November 2009. Arts. 4 (called by the People's Assembly; early election within three months of a vacancy) and 25 (absolute majority of those voting with 50% turnout; runoff of the top two within two weeks; repeat election).

law-local.title: Закон Республики Абхазия «О выборах в органы местного самоуправления»
law-local.note: Arts. 1 (assemblies of the city, districts, towns, settlements, and villages elected in single-member districts for four years) and 5 (all held on one day, called by the President).

law-atu.title: Закон Республики Абхазия «Об управлении в административно-территориальных единицах Республики Абхазия»
law-atu.note: Art. 2: the city of Sukhum; the district towns Gagra, Gudauta, Ochamchyra, Tkuarchal, and Gal; the town of New Athos; and the Gagra, Gudauta, Sukhum, Gulripsh, Ochamchyra, Tkuarchal, and Gal districts. Local self-government acts through the assemblies (Sobraniye) of the district, city, town, settlement, and village.

classes.name: Выборы депутатов Народного Собрания – Парламента Республики Абхазия
classes.finest_note: The Central Election Commission declares results by constituency; precinct protocols are posted by the constituency commissions.
classes.note: 35 deputies elected for five years in single-member constituencies (Constitution art. 37). A candidate needs an absolute majority with at least 25% turnout; otherwise the top two meet in a runoff within two weeks (law arts. 34, 36). The Supreme Council elected in the autumn of 1991, before the Republic's span here, sat as the first convocation until 1996 under the 1994 Constitution's transitional provisions; that election belongs to Georgia's census.

cadence.runoff_rule: Top two in a constituency within two weeks where no candidate won an absolute majority

classes.name: Выборы Президента Республики Абхазия
classes.finest_note: The Central Election Commission publishes the national result and the count by district and city.
classes.note: The President and Vice-President are elected together for five years (Constitution arts. 49, 54). A candidate needs more than half of those voting, with turnout of at least half the register; otherwise the top two meet within two weeks, where a plurality wins with 25% turnout (law art. 25). A vacancy is filled within three months (art. 4). The 3 October 2004 election, which the Commission declared for Sergei Bagapsh, was repeated on 12 January 2005.

classes.name: Выборы депутатов Собраний районов и города Сухум
classes.note: Each district assembly and the Sukhum city assembly is elected for four years in single-member constituencies, all local assemblies on one day called by the President (law arts. 1, 5). The heads of the district and city administrations are appointed by the President from the assembly's members (Constitution art. 79), so there is no mayoral election. Each election is run by the territory's own election commission.
